This is compatibility evidence only until the structured row-roster/log/checkpoint fields above are populated.

Requires a uv-MANAGED CPython 3.10 (cpython-3.10.18): cpa-tools's numba/llvmlite pin needs Python >=3.7,<3.11, and the pod's system /usr/bin/python3.10 lacks _tkinter (cpa/_model.py has a spurious `from tkinter import N`; the managed build bundles Tcl/Tk).

Lock derived by pinning the 2023-era stack cpa-tools targets: scvi-tools==0.20.3 (has parse_use_gpu_arg; newer scvi removed it and imports the removed jaxlib.xla_extension), jax/jaxlib==0.4.38 (newest <0.5 exposing jaxlib.xla_extension), anndata<0.11 (0.10.9; anndata 0.11 removed SparseDataset), numpy 1.26.4, plus seaborn>=0.13 (0.13.2; old seaborn calls the removed matplotlib.cm.register_cmap), and scanpy + requests (imported by cpa/scvi but not pulled).

rdkit is the modern wheel (2026.3.3); cpa-tools declares the abandoned rdkit-pypi which double-installs the rdkit namespace and triggers a Boost.Python converter error — the lock excludes rdkit-pypi, so a fresh `uv pip sync` of the lock is clean.
Set MPLBACKEND=Agg for headless matplotlib at runtime.

runtime_notes: Era-consistent re-pin after an observed Norman runtime smoke. cell-gears 0.1.2 declares no useful version bounds, so the prior newest-everything lock passed import but crashed at runtime. This is compatibility evidence only until the structured row-roster/log/checkpoint fields above are populated.

Landmine 1 (PertData.load): pandas 3.0 makes string columns default to `str` dtype, so `adata.obs.index.values` is a pandas StringArray that anndata rejects (`IndexError: Unknown indexer <StringArray>`). Fixed by pandas<3.0 (2.2.3 -> object-dtype indices).

Landmine 2 (GEARS.__init__): `adata.X[adata.obs.condition == 'ctrl']` indexes a scipy sparse matrix with a pandas boolean Series; scipy 1.18's new sparse indexing calls `idx.nonzero()` on it (removed from pandas). Fixed by scipy<1.14 (1.11.4 -> old sparse indexing; forces numpy<1.28 -> 1.26.4).

Final era stack: numpy 1.26.4 + pandas 2.2.3 + scipy 1.11.4 + anndata 0.10.9 (+ torch 2.6.0+cu124 / torch_geometric 2.8.0 kept for A100 CUDA 12.4). The operator observed PertData.load('norman') + simulation split seed 1 + dataloader + model initialization + 1 epoch completing without a compatibility crash; COMPOSE seal-safety remains unverified because the training roster was not captured.
Fresh venv (not the pod's original system-python gears_env, which was import-only-verified and pandas-mutated during diagnosis).

indexes.torch_pin: torch==2.6.0 (resolves to 2.6.0+cu124 via the cu124 index)

isolation_rationale: GEARS (torch-geometric) and CPA (scvi-tools/lightning) carry independent, frequently-conflicting torch-ecosystem constraints, and the activation-time guarded seam invokes each baseline as an isolated subprocess backend. Two per-baseline environments are therefore the correct unit of reproducibility; neither shares the main ALIVE .venv.
